column3: shred -s 0 must not modify the file
split -n must not overlap chunks
binary input must remain byte-safe
dd read errors must affect exit status
tee must stop after downstream close
xargs must batch long input
large input paths must stream
cp empty files must succeed
cp -r must propagate child failures
diff unified headers must be valid
diff must distinguish CRLF and LF
seq must not truncate at one million
tsort must honor graph constraints
stat mode owner and timestamps must match
tac must preserve CRLF
text tools must handle CRLF consistently
uniq must not add CRLF
cut must not duplicate delimiter-free records
fmt must honor width
test must implement file time operators
id -g must report the effective group
dirname and basename must handle root and trailing slash
date must parse relative dates
cp link option must be implemented
chmod must accept short octal modes
sed -i must preserve attributes
paths over MAX_PATH must work
xxd reverse mode must work
mv must replace readonly destinations
join must support -j aliases
sdiff -o must not write stdout
leading dash operands must be accepted
printf dynamic width and precision must work
printf %q must work
test logical operators and grouping must work
ls must sort explicit operands
head positive count must match GNU
numfmt option variants must work
pr page length must work
unix2dos and d2u must preserve missing final newline
ptx output must match GNU
stdbuf modes must work
locale keyword output must work
sed empty match after a non-empty match must not be substituted or counted
env -i child environment block must contain exactly the given assignments in order
env printed listing must preserve assignment order, not alphabetical order
env must pass option-like arguments after the command name to the command
timeout with --signal=KILL must report 137 on timeout
timeout on the TERM path must report 124 on timeout
ls bare --color must colorize like always
ln --backup control and backup line must match GNU
stat --printf must expand \xHH escapes and honor -c over -t
ls quoting-style locale and --sort prefixes must match GNU
grep negative context length must be rejected
sed address escapes must keep the backslash
sort -V must use filevercmp ordering
uniq -w -1 must be rejected
tail -z headers must use newline separators
echo -e must print \E literally
tsort ready queue must be FIFO with reverse-read successor order
tsort extra operand is a usage error with try-help
tsort odd-token diagnostic carries the input name
tsort open failure uses the GNU errno diagnostic form
od obsolescent letters -D -e -H -O must be accepted
od format specifications accumulate in argv order
ptx --format=tex selects the TeX output format
ptx --format invalid value uses the argmatch diagnostic
uniq --group invalid value uses the argmatch diagnostic
sort --sort invalid value uses the argmatch diagnostic
sort --sort accepts unique argmatch prefixes
cksum default CRC on a regular file
csplit pattern split piece sizes and files
nl -n rz -w 3 with custom separator and blank line
fold -w 5 hard wrap
expand -t 4 advances to multiple-of-4 stops
unexpand -t 4 collapses leading blanks to tabs
split -n 3 byte partitions are 4/3/3 with --verbose
fmt -p prefix paragraph refill
pr -t -l 5 +2 starts at page 2
paste -s serial mode with custom delimiter
comm standard three-column merge
comm open failure uses the bare GNU form
tac reverses lines
tac -r -s regex separator
cat -E shows CR of CRLF as ^M
cut decreasing range diagnostic
cut -d : -f 2 field extraction
tr equivalence class in string2 is fatal
tr range translation
join repeated -o accumulates
join -o 0.5 invalid field specifier diagnostic
head -c K suffix-only value means 1 x suffix
head invalid number quotes operand without elide '-'
tail -n 0 with missing operand exits 0
tail --follow invalid value uses argmatch diagnostic
wc --total unique prefix accepted
wc --files0-from bad record skipped, others counted
wc directory operand prints zero line plus diagnostic
fmt -w 20 refill
head UTF-8 BOM file stays on the byte path
